TEXT.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

S.FORM: Annata ni-ierroua ta ti Jesus ninnim ki wæ'i tou ourou ki 'Ou-vavatoug-han ki Hali-daæu-'en tou Bethanien tou æ̈-i-a-kou-an ti Lazarus ka ni-ma-patei-ato kalahei, ka ni-pa-pat-timæu-en tyn ki ni-kapatei-an.
S.TRANSL: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
逾越節前六日，耶穌來到伯大尼，就是他叫拉撒路從死裏復活之處。

S.FORM: Ka ni-tmanang tyni-æn hynna ki hi-addou doung-an, ka pi-leileig-in ti Martha: ka ti La-zarus ta saät neini-æn ka i-tou lam tyni-æn mierraoung tou avok-kan.
S.TRANSL: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.
有人在那裏給耶穌預備筵席；馬大伺候，拉撒路也在那同耶穌坐席的人中。

S.FORM: Irou ka ni-ara ti Maria sa-sat ki tingting ki rapoul ka Nar-dus ka mangal, ka assi ni hourad, ni s'a la-ymmag-hin tyn ta rahpal ti Jesus, ka ni-rihkagh ki vouk-kugh tyn ki rahpal tyn, ka mouh-tmouk ta ait ki rapoul tou talagh kanna.
S.TRANSL: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.
馬利亞就拿着一斤極貴的真哪噠香膏，抹耶穌的腳，又用自己頭髮去擦，屋裏就滿了膏的香氣。

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-k'ma ta saät ki Pahtatæutæu-han tyn, ti Judas ka ti Simon Iskariot, ka si-vanavana-ah tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, which should betray him,
有一個門徒，就是那將要賣耶穌的加略人猶大，

S.FORM: Kaumang ka assi papapei-la ta rapoul katta ki tourou kæ'æ-toug-han ki malyttouk ka ni-phæn ki anna ta malimouk?
S.TRANSL: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?
說：「這香膏為甚麼不賣三十兩銀子賙濟窮人呢？」

S.FORM: Ni-pa-sousou-en tyn ta at-ta, assi alei ka pæh-kbo-in tyn ta malimouk, ra alei-appa ka ta-ma-haouzong ta teni, ka akou pautti mei-koua ki atta ka pou-kou-an-ato.
S.TRANSL: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.
他說這話，並不是掛念窮人，乃因他是個賊，又帶着錢囊，常取其中所存的。

S.FORM: Annata ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus, Pa-sykkounoung-au ta teni: Ni-haä tyn ta atta tou wæ'i ki ravak-kei jau-an.
S.TRANSL: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.
耶穌說：「由她吧！她是為我安葬之日存留的。

S.FORM: Ka i-tou-kakoua ymou-mi-æn ta malimouk, ra a'ou-si-ah kamou myhkakoua jau-an.
S.TRANSL: For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.
因為常有窮人和你們同在，只是你們不常有我。」

S.FORM: Ka makoilalaulau ka ma-batoung ki Joden ta mou-mha ki æ̈-i-a-kouan tyn hynna: ka ni-ier-roua assi dyk alei ti Jesus-an, alei-appa ka kmytta-ah ta neni ti La-zarus-an, ka ni-papattimæuæh-en tyn ki ni-kapatei-an.
S.TRANSL: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
有許多猶太人知道耶穌在那裏，就來了，不但是為耶穌的緣故，也是要看他從死裏所復活的拉撒路。

S.FORM: Ka ni-mattæ'i-saal mat-tæ'i-kyppou ki sou ta Tama-P'ghik ka Si-bavau ka pakapa-tei-al-appa ta neni ti Lazarus-an.
S.TRANSL: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;
但祭司長商議連拉撒路也要殺了；

S.FORM: Ka mabatoung ki Joden ta ni-d'marang mou-koua alei ty-ni-æn, ka ni-tna-'msing [appa] ti Jesus-an.
S.TRANSL: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.
因有好些猶太人為拉撒路的緣故，回去信了耶穌。

S.FORM: Tou sasat ki wæ'i ka tou ææugh makoi-lalaulau ka maba-toung ka ierrou-'ato tou Ou-vava-toug-han, dou millingigh ka sah-ka kouan ti Jesus mou-Jerusalem,
S.TRANSL: On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
第二天，有許多上來過節的人聽見耶穌將到耶路撒冷，

S.FORM: Ni-ara nein ta pehil ki pærænnæh ka Palm, ka ni-tpæpæ-næh dmoummadoumma tyni-æn ni-makou-langægh, Hosanna, pakariang-auh ta teni loumoulough ka ierroua tou Nanang ki MEIRANG ka Mei-sasou ka Si-bavau tou Israel.
S.TRANSL: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.
就拿着棕樹枝出去迎接他，喊着說： 和散那！ 奉主名來的以色列王是應當稱頌的！

S.FORM: Ka ni-kabalei ti Jesus ta patak ki louang ka haäva [ka ezel], ka ni-i-tou-'avan tyn ki an-na, mama ki na sasoulat,
S.TRANSL: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,
耶穌得了一個驢駒，就騎上，如經上所記的說：

S.FORM: Ynna mahttakout Tati-mi-en ki Sion: kytt-ei, ierrarou-roua ta Mei-sasou ka Si-bavau ymhou-an itou-ava'-tou patak ki louang ka 'yppou ka haäva.
S.TRANSL: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.
錫安的民哪，不要懼怕！ 你的王騎着驢駒來了。

S.FORM: Ra assi 'ou-mhg-an ta at-ta ki Pahtatæutæu-han tyn tou naunamou: irou-ra ni-pou-va-vau-en ki kidi ta ti Jesus, annata ni-hybbalei nein ka ni-soullat-ten ta mææ-koua tyni-æn, ka ni-pam't-appa nein ta atta ty-ni-an.
S.TRANSL: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.
這些事門徒起先不明白，等到耶穌得了榮耀以後才想起這話是指着他寫的，並且眾人果然向他這樣行了。

S.FORM: Ka makoilalaulau kanna ka na lam tyn ta ni-gmail ki ni-tætææm tyn ti Lazarus pa-'æu-pænæh tou ravak, ka ni-pa-pattimæuæh tyn tyni-æn ki ni-kapatei-an.
S.TRANSL: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.
當耶穌呼喚拉撒路，叫他從死復活出墳墓的時候，同耶穌在那裏的眾人就作見證。

S.FORM: Alei ki anna ni-dmoum-madoumma-appa tyni-æn ta ma-koilalaulau, alei ka ni-illing-'hgen nein ka ni-pam't-ten tyn ta ni-pou-kidi-en katta.
S.TRANSL: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.
眾人因聽見耶穌行了這神蹟，就去迎接他。

S.FORM: Annata ni-mattæ'i ta-væ-tavæh ta Fariseen, Kytta'n-noumi kauwa ka assei-moumi pouthanin? kytt-'ei, smala-dyllough tyni-æn ta ymmid ki næi.
S.TRANSL: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.
法利賽人彼此說：「看哪，你們是徒勞無益，世人都隨從他去了。」

S.FORM: Ka akoume'-âto hynna ta rarouma ki Griekken ka na taou k'anna ka ni-sabavau ki deip-eih nein tou 'Ou-vavatoug-han.
S.TRANSL: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:
那時，上來過節禮拜的人中，有幾個希臘人。

S.FORM: Neni ta ni-mou-koua ti Filippus-an ka makka Bethzai-da ka tou Galilæa, ni-tmoumi-mia tyni-æn, koun, Meirang, mamoei-kame kmytta ti Jesus-an,
S.TRANSL: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.
他們來見加利利、伯賽大的腓力，求他說：「先生，我們願意見耶穌。」

S.FORM: Ni-mou-koua ta ti Filippus vannavanna ti Andreas-an: ti Andreas ti Filippus-appa ta ni vannavanna ki atta ti Jesus-an,
S.TRANSL: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.
腓力去告訴安得烈，安得烈同腓力去告訴耶穌。

S.FORM: Ra ti Jesus ta ni-mat-tæ'i-v'lli neini-æn, k'ma, Ier-rou-ato ta kidi ki talei ka pou-vavau'eih ki kidi ta Alak ki kaæu-loung.
S.TRANSL: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.
耶穌說：「人子得榮耀的時候到了。

S.FORM: Missing, missing koun-nau-kamou, Heirou assi t'koua tou næi mapatei ta vyttourough ki sifvæh myhkakoua tou saät ta anna, irou ra mapatei makka-tapang ta anna makka-voua.
S.TRANSL: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
我實實在在地告訴你們，一粒麥子不落在地裏死了，仍舊是一粒，若是死了，就結出許多子粒來。

S.FORM: Timamang ta mævæ'an-gö ki kæuæ-han tyn patau-rum-ma-ah ki anna: ti mamang-appa mavahier ki kæuag-han tyn tou næi katta, mahaa-ah ki anna tou kauag-han ka myhkakoua myd-darynnough.
S.TRANSL: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.
愛惜自己生命的，就失喪生命；在這世上恨惡自己生命的，就要保守生命到永生。

S.FORM: Heirou ti mamang ta 'mi-rong jau-an, smaladiloug-â jau-an: ka toumamang ta æ-i-a-koua-en-nau, æ-i-a-kou-al-appa hynna ta tama-'irong jau-an. Ka ti mamang ta' mirong jau-an teni ta 'illig-hau ki Rama.
S.TRANSL: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.
若有人服事我，就當跟從我；我在哪裏，服事我的人也要在那裏；若有人服事我，我父必尊重他。」

S.FORM: Hnyn mieringau ta vatti-au ki voulas: ka mang ta sou-a-mau? Rama, hami-ei-koh tou ki-di ki tæ'læi k'atta. Ra alei-appa ki anna ierou-ato-koh tou kidi ki tæ'lei katta.
S.TRANSL: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.
「我現在心裏憂愁，我說甚麼才好呢？父啊，救我脫離這時候；但我原是為這時候來的。

S.FORM: Rama pou-vavau-ei ki kidi ta Nanang oho. Annata ni-ieroua ta yngau makka toun-noun ki vullum, [koun], Ni-pou-vavau-en-nau ki kidi ka mi-la-ah-koh pou-vavau ki kidi [ty-ni-æn.
S.TRANSL: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.
父啊，願你榮耀你的名！」當時就有聲音從天上來，說：「我已經榮耀了我的名，還要再榮耀。」

S.FORM: Annata makoilalaulau ka mi-touhko hynna millingigh [ki atta,] ni-k'ma, akoume-âto ki 'ltæh. Ni-k'ma ta rarouma, ka yngau-en ta teni ki Tama-Gnau.
S.TRANSL: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.
站在旁邊的眾人聽見，就說：「打雷了。」還有人說：「有天使對他說話。」

S.FORM: Ni-mattæ'i-v'lli ta ti Je-sus ka ni-koun tyn, Assi alei jau-an ka ni-pam't-tin ta yngau k'at-ta, râ alei-appa ymoumi-æn.
S.TRANSL: Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.
耶穌說：「這聲音不是為我，是為你們來的。

S.FORM: Annata hnyn ta dung-dung-en ki næi k'atta: aryng-an-nei hnyn pou-tauwagh ta Mei-sasou ki næi k'atta.
S.TRANSL: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.
現在這世界受審判，這世界的王要被趕出去。

S.FORM: Ka ti jau rou pou-vavau-eil-lato-koh makka næi hmi-ymd-ah-koh bihit neini-æn pa-ou-koua jau-an.
S.TRANSL: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.
我若從地上被舉起來，就要吸引萬人來歸我。」

S.FORM: Ni-pasousou-en tyn ta atta ka pou-ki di-eih kapatei-an ka mama ki mang ka kapatei-eih tyn.)
S.TRANSL: This he said, signifying what death he should die.
耶穌這話原是指着自己將要怎樣死說的。

S.FORM: N-imattæ'i-v'lli tyni-æn ta makoilalaulau, Ni-millingig-kame tou Tatouhko ka itou-ka-koua-ah itou rynnough ta ti Chri-stus: ka mattæ'i-mang kow ym-hou, ka pou-vavau-eil-ato ta Alak ki ka'æuloung? Timang ta Alak kanna ki ka'æuloung?
S.TRANSL: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?
眾人回答說：「我們聽見律法上有話說，基督是永存的，你怎麼說『人子必須被舉起來』呢？這人子是誰呢？」

S.FORM: Annata ni-kma ta ti Je-sus neini-æn, Assi madallia ki kidi ka æ̈-i-a-koua-appa ta ræmæh ymoumi-æn: mou-naunang-â dou akou ræmæh ymoumi-æn, alei ka assi-kamou tah-koua-eih ki karumdumman. Ka timamang ta mou-naunang tou karumdum-man, assi mou-mhga tou mamang ka sah-kakouan tyn.
S.TRANSL: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.
耶穌對他們說：「光在你們中間還有不多的時候，應當趁着有光行走，免得黑暗臨到你們；那在黑暗裏行走的，不知道往何處去。

S.FORM: Dou akoume'-appa ta ræmæh ymoumi-æn tna-'msing-a ki ræmæh, alei ka alalak-ah-ka-mou ki karæræmæ'-han. Ta ma-mang k'atta ni-pa-sousou-en ti Jesus: ka rou d'marang ni-hmaä tyni-æn pa-'ou-tawagh neini-æn.
S.TRANSL: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.
你們應當趁着有光，信從這光，使你們成為光明之子。」

S.FORM: Meita ka madagh kma-hynna ki na pou-kakidi ni-pam't-ten tyn tou æmæh neini-æn, assi ni-tna-'msing ta neni tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:
他雖然在他們面前行了許多神蹟，他們還是不信他。

S.FORM: Alei ka ka-pa-væut-auh ta na sou ti Esaias ka na Tama-Mattæi-tan, ka ni-pa-sousou-en tyn, Meirang, timang ta ni-tna-'msing ki na patta-sasou-i-an? Ni-pou-pænæ'-hen ti-mang-ang ta pariou ti JEHOVA?
S.TRANSL: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?
這是要應驗先知以賽亞的話，說： 主啊，我們所傳的有誰信呢？ 主的膀臂向誰顯露呢？

S.FORM: Alei ki anna assi ni-tna-lpough tna-msing, alei ka ni-mat-tæ'i-la ta ti Esaias;
S.TRANSL: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,
他們所以不能信，因為以賽亞又說：

S.FORM: Ni-paka-voutta-an tyn ta matta nein, ni-pakat'æh-en tyn ta tintin nein: ka assi k'ytta-eih ki matta nein, ka assi 'ou-mhga-ei' ki tintin nein, ki pasi-lala-eih ta neni ka smimia-ah koh neini-æn.
S.TRANSL: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.
主叫他們瞎了眼， 硬了心， 免得他們眼睛看見， 心裏明白，回轉過來， 我就醫治他們。

S.FORM: Atta ta ni-pasousou-en ti Esaias, dou k'ytt'-an tyn ta kei-rang-an ki kidi tyn, mattæ'i-mymmia tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.
以賽亞因為看見他的榮耀，就指着他說這話。

S.FORM: Irou-appa k'anna ka ni-tna-'msing tyni-æn ta mabatoung ka na Meisasou: râ alei ki Fari-seen assi nein ni-pattæ'i-æmæh ta anna, alei ka assi pou-tauwagh-æuh ta neni ki Pæuisasaäl-lan.
S.TRANSL: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:
雖然如此，官長中卻有好些信他的，只因法利賽人的緣故，就不承認，恐怕被趕出會堂。

S.FORM: Ka ni-kasaoun-nen nein mavæ'ango ta louloug-han ki kæ'-euloung ki louloug-han ki Alid.
S.TRANSL: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.
這是因他們愛人的榮耀過於愛上帝的榮耀。

S.FORM: Ka ni-mako-lang-æh ta ti Jesus, ka ni-koun tyn, Ti-ma-mang ta tna-'msing jau-an, assi tna-msing jau-an, ra tyni-æn-appa ka ni-madingi jau-an.
S.TRANSL: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.
耶穌大聲說：「信我的，不是信我，乃是信那差我來的。

S.FORM: Ka timamang ta kmytta jau-an, kmytta tyni-æn ka ni-ma-dingi jau-an.
S.TRANSL: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.
人看見我，就是看見那差我來的。

S.FORM: Ti jau ta ræmæh ka ier-rou'-âto tou næi, alei ka veia-veiægh ka tama-tnamsing jau-an, assi itou-kakoua-ah tou karum-dum-man.
S.TRANSL: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.
我到世上來，乃是光，叫凡信我的，不住在黑暗裏。

S.FORM: Heirou ka millingig-âl-ato ta ti mamang ki sou-au, rou assi tna-'msing, assi koh dmung-dung tyni-æn. Ka assi-koh ierrou-ato tou dungdung-ei-mau ki næi, râ alei-appa ka paka-riang-ei-mau ta næi.
S.TRANSL: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
若有人聽見我的話不遵守，我不審判他。我來本不是要審判世界，乃是要拯救世界。

S.FORM: Timamang ta mouroung pou-tauwagh jau-an, ka assi mat-ta-ryh ki sou-au, akoumea ki dmungdung-ah tyni-æn: sou k'atta ka ni-pa-sousou-en-nau, at-ta ta dmungdung-ah tyni-æn tou wæ'i ka tou æ̈'æugh.
S.TRANSL: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.
棄絕我、不領受我話的人，有審判他的－就是我所講的道在末日要審判他。

S.FORM: Ka assi-koh ni sykkou-noung masousou, râ ti Rama-ap-pa ka ni-madingi jau-an, teni ta ni-makou-sou jau-an ki mamang ka koua-au-mau, ki mamang-ap-pa ka pa-sousou-au-mau.
S.TRANSL: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
因為我沒有憑着自己講，惟有差我來的父已經給我命令，叫我說甚麼，講甚麼。

S.FORM: Ka kavana-en-nau ka kæuag-han ka myhkakoua myd-darynnough ta pahkou-sou-en tyn. Anna ta kamamang ka pasou-sou-en-nau mattæ'i-komma-koh hynna, mama ki ni-pa-sousou-en ti Rama jau-an.
S.TRANSL: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.
我也知道他的命令就是永生。故此，我所講的話正是照着父對我所說的。」
